## TouchDirt v1.0

First public release of TouchDirt for the Samsung Galaxy A04 (SM-A045F).

### Builds

- Vanilla - Enforcing
- Vanilla - Permissive
- ReSukiSU - Enforcing
- ReSukiSU - Permissive

### Features

- ReSukiSU
- F2FS discard-thread fix
- Fake uname
- Optional SELinux permissive mode

### Installation

Flash the appropriate AnyKernel3 ZIP using either a compatible custom recovery or using [Kernel Flasher](https://github.com/fatalcoder524/KernelFlasher/releases/tag/v1.6.0).

**Make sure you select the correct build for your setup.**
